value.rationale: The five-point model is the smallest finite representative of the basic rank-two graph \(S^1\vee S^1\). A complete description of its directly realizable \(H_1\)-endomorphisms measures information lost when one replaces the homotopy category by actual maps on a cardinality-minimal finite model. The contrast is sharp: the CW bouquet realizes arbitrary integral two-by-two matrices, whereas the five-point model realizes exactly \(31\), and invertibility is equivalent to homeomorphism.
